title: Matchmaking weighs party size more heavily
detail: Solo players report noticeably fewer matches against full 5-stacks since Frostfall. Not in the notes; consistent across several independent tracking threads.

title: Legendary drops from Supply Crates dropped by a third
detail: A 20,000-crate community sample shows the legendary rate falling from ~1.5% to ~1.0%, matching the datamined value. Patch notes were silent.

title: Hit registration: server now rewinds up to 150 ms
detail: Developer comment clarifies that 'improved hit registration' means lag compensation was raised from 100 ms to 150 ms, so high-ping shots count more often.

title: Ranked servers may be running at a higher tick rate
detail: Netgraph captures suggest 64 Hz updates in Ranked matches (previously 30 Hz). Not yet confirmed by the developers.
